question.text: What evidence is required to compare our Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer solution with a competitor for Aerospace / Defense without making unsupported claims?

exchange.sent: What evidence is required to compare our Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer solution with a competitor for Aerospace / Defense without making unsupported claims?

answer.answer:
### Short answer
To compare a Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer solution with a competitor for Aerospace / Defense, the evidence must include an A&D application source, our formal product specifications and configuration limits, competitor official or third-party-verified specifications, and a source that supports the exact comparison under comparable conditions.[2][3][6][7][12][16][31][66]
### Required evidence
| Required evidence | Why it is needed | Current support / gap |
|---|---|---|
| A source that ties the use case to Aerospace / Defense, not just to instruments in general. | The raw source only shows an Aerospace / Defense context by URL and separately names “Signal Generator” and “Signal Analyzer.” | The URL is an aerospace-defense page, and another raw passage only lists “Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer,” so the direct A&D solution-to-competitor comparison is not established by these passages.[98][99] |
| A&D test or application evidence, such as DO-160 EMC or satellite payload TVAC testing. | DO-160 is cited in a military / aviation drone EMC proposal context, and TVAC satellite payload test setups can include a signal generator and signal analyzer. | DO-160 context is supported, and TVAC setup components are supported, but neither passage compares R&S with a competitor.[16][31] |
| Our formal product documentation for the Signal Generator. | SMW200A claims should come from its configuration guide and specifications, which record configuration, ordering, RF/baseband performance, interfaces, environmental data and options. | SMW200A source documents are the configuration guide PD 3606.8037.92 Version 06.00 May 2024 and specifications PD 3606.8037.22 Version 31.00 May 2026.[2] |
| Our formal product documentation for the Signal Analyzer. | FSW claims should come from its specifications, because the FSW page notes the document version and that data without tolerance limits is not binding. | FSW specifications are PD 5215.6749.22 Version 17.01 September 2025, and the page notes data without tolerance limits is not binding.[6] |
| Comparable R&S specifications with conditions. | SMW200A product data applies only after ambient storage, warm-up, environmental compliance, calibration interval compliance and internal automatic adjustments. | SMW200A warranted and non-warranted terms are defined, including that typ., nominal and measured values are not guaranteed.[3] |
| Comparable analyzer specifications with conditions. | FSW product data applies only after ambient storage, warm-up, environmental compliance, calibration interval compliance and internal automatic adjustments. | FSW common conditions include calibration interval, temperature ranges, frequency resolution and AC supply information.[66] |
| Exact R&S model, option and bandwidth evidence. | SMW200A and FSW capability depends on RF path, baseband, analysis bandwidth and software options. | SMW200A supports RF path A up to 100 kHz to 67 GHz, RF path B up to 100 kHz to 44 GHz, and wideband RF modulation bandwidth up to 2 GHz with the cited conditions.[62] |
| Exact analyzer model, option and bandwidth evidence. | FSW capability depends on model and analysis bandwidth option. | FSW models cover up to 85 GHz, and FSW85 with FSW-B90G can extend to 90 GHz.[5][68] |
| Exact FSW analysis-bandwidth option evidence. | A fair analyzer comparison needs the installed bandwidth option rather than a generic FSW claim. | FSW analysis bandwidth options listed include 40 MHz, 80 MHz, 160 MHz, 320 MHz, 512 MHz, 1.2 GHz, 2 GHz, 4.4 GHz, 6.4 GHz and 8.312 GHz, with model and installation limits.[67] |
| Competitor official datasheets, configuration guides, release notes, option catalogs and test conditions. | Existing Keysight battle-card material is not Keysight official documentation and lacks formal SKU specifications, order numbers, option codes, release status and test conditions. | The Keysight page explicitly says Keysight-related competitor descriptions need Keysight official or third-party evidence, and that the battle card lacks formal datasheets, versions, order numbers, option codes, release status and test conditions.[7] |
| Competitor official evidence for Anritsu if Anritsu is the competitor. | Existing Anritsu material is an R&S internal battle card and cannot be treated as Anritsu official specifications or market facts. | Anritsu frequency range, bandwidth, data rate, option code, software tools and support model need Anritsu official datasheets, release notes or support terms.[12] |
| A source that directly supports any superiority, “only vendor,” ranking, lower TCO or fewer-boxes claim. | R&S battle-card superiority language is sales positioning, not binding technical specification. | The Anritsu comparison page says only-platform, industry-leading, widest-frequency-range and lower-TCO statements are sales language and should not be treated as verifiable technical specifications.[21] |
| A calculation or evidence base for TCO claims. | Lower TCO or fewer-calibration claims need a cited calculation or source. | The Anritsu offensive-plays passage says the “fewer boxes / lower TCO / higher throughput” message lacks a TCO formula.[87] |
| Official standards or test-plan evidence for A&D compliance claims. | The DO-160 page is not an official RTCA DO-160 standard summary and cannot support full category, limit, waveform, setup or pass/fail criteria claims. | The DO-160 page explicitly says not to infer full DO-160 section category, limit, waveform, setup or pass/fail criteria from it.[84] |
| Environmental and calibration evidence for satellite-payload or TVAC claims. | TVAC solution-level material is not a product qualification certificate and lacks chamber pressure, temperature profile, dwell time, calibration interval and uncertainty budget. | The TVAC page says the source does not provide those TVAC details and must not be treated as a product qualification certificate.[32] |
### Minimum evidence package before making the comparison
1. Identify the exact Aerospace / Defense test scenario, such as DO-160 RF susceptibility, RF emissions, lightning-induced transients, ESD, or satellite-payload TVAC testing, and cite the applicable standard or test procedure version.[17][18][81][82][83]  
2. Identify the exact R&S Signal Generator model, RF path, baseband module, bandwidth, software options and warranted specification conditions.[1][2][3][62][65]  
3. Identify the exact R&S Signal Analyzer model, frequency range, analysis-bandwidth option, firmware or measurement option and warranted specification conditions.[6][66][67][68][69]  
4. Identify the competitor model, hardware configuration, software/options, document version, release status and measurement conditions from competitor official documentation or third-party evidence.[7][12]  
5. Compare only metrics stated for both sides under comparable conditions, such as frequency range, modulation bandwidth, analysis bandwidth, software function, calibration conditions, environmental conditions and uncertainty treatment.[3][6][66][67]  
6. Exclude unsupported claims about market share, customer adoption, “only vendor,” lower TCO, fewer boxes or superiority unless a cited source directly supports that exact claim.[21][74][87]

Keysight
[[Keysight]]（圖中亦寫作 [[是德科技]]）是在既有 PCB 測試圖像來源中被列為高頻高速 [[PCB]] 測試解決方案相關公司的測試量測廠商名稱；在 [[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中，Keysight 也被描述為大型美國 test & measurement vendor 與 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 wireless device testing 競品供應商。

Keysight › R&S 2026-02-26 battle card 中的 Keysight 描述
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26）：

- Keysight 被描述為 large US-based test & measurement vendor，總部位於 Santa Rosa, California, USA，員工數約 **16,800+**。
- 來源說 Keysight 在 semiconductor、aerospace / defense、cloud 與 wireless testing 具 strong market presence。
- 來源說 Keysight 在美國與 key semiconductor accounts 很強，並宣稱有 broad ecosystem partnerships：24/25 top tech companies、14/15 operators、25/25 semiconductor companies。
- 來源列出 Keysight portfolio：[[Keysight UXM]] 5G Wireless Test Platforms（[[Keysight E7515B]]、[[Keysight E7515W]]、[[Keysight E7515P]]、[[Keysight E7515E]]、[[Keysight E7515R]]）、[[ProbSim]] channel emulators、[[Nemo]] field test tools、[[RaySim]] digital twin engine、[[Atlas]] AI-powered device test、C-V2X 與 cybersecurity tools。
- 來源說 Keysight UXM portfolio fragmented across multiple hardware SKUs，每個 SKU 有不同 bandwidth、RF ports、Wi-Fi、Rel-17/18 capabilities。
- 來源說 Keysight software model 分散於 Atlas、Channel Studio、RaySim、Nemo、WLAN tools 與 UXM-specific feature options，並稱 no unified automation environment。
- 來源說 Keysight support model 使用 tiered [[KeysightCare]] model：Assured、Enhanced、Application Software Support，另有 optional warranty and calibration assurance plan。

Anritsu
[[Anritsu]] 是一間日本 test & measurement vendor；在 [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中被描述為 R&S radio communication tester portfolio 的競品供應商。

Anritsu › Battle card 中的公司輪廓
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card]]（2026-02-26）：

- Headquarters：Kanagawa, Japan。
- Company size：約 4,000+ employees global。
- Market positioning：source 稱其在 Japan T&M market share 為 #1，但 global footprint 較弱。
- Strengths：good LTE/eCall signaling（[[Anritsu MD8475B]]）、solid RF heritage、strong Japanese operator relationships。
- Support model：traditional hardware service；source 評為 software ecosystem 較弱、cloud capabilities limited，且 TestDeck 是唯一 DX tool。

以上為 R&S internal battle card 對競品的描述；來源未引用 Anritsu 官方文件或第三方市場資料。

Anritsu › 使用限制
- 本頁目前只依 R&S 內部 battle card 建立；不能把 source 對 Anritsu 的弱點敘事視為 Anritsu 官方規格或市場事實。
- Anritsu 產品的 frequency range、bandwidth、data rate、option code、software tools 與 support model 需要另以 Anritsu 官方 datasheet / release notes / support terms 驗證。
- 來源中出現的 R&S superiority / only vendor / lower TCO 等語句屬 sales positioning，不是可直接引用的技術規格。

NTN signal generator solutions › 與 NTN validation / conformance 的關係
- [[5G NTN validation and testing]]：較寬的 NTN validation、partner collaboration、CMX500 / SMBV100B / Viasat / Gatehouse / MediaTek PR 語境。
- [[NR-NTN conformance testing]]：偏 UE / GCF / PTCRB / TS8980 / CMX500 conformance validation。
- [[5G NR SAN conformance testing]]：本來源新增的 Satellite Access Node 測試概念，聚焦 SAN transmitter、receiver、performance 與 OTA chapters。
- [[NTN propagation emulation and fading]]：既有 CMX500 PR 中 propagation emulation 與 fading 的概念；本來源補充 SMW200A dynamic fading / Doppler / path delay 實作線索。

NTN signal generator solutions
[[NTN signal generator solutions]] 是 [[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]]（封面標示 12-2025；末頁標示 Last updated: 08/25）中用來整理 [[R&S SMW200A]]、[[R&S FSW]] 與相關 software options 在 [[3GPP]] [[NTN]] 測試中的 solution-level 應用框架。

NTN signal generator solutions › 來源中的 solution 分層
[[3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR]] 將 NTN testing 分為四類：

- Component Testing。
- [[Satellite Access Node]]（[[SAN]]）Testing。
- End-to-end System Testing。
- User Equipment（UE）Testing。

來源可讀內容主要展開前三者，尤其是 [[R&S SMW200A]] 的 channel emulation、[[5G NR SAN conformance testing]] 與 [[SMW200A NTN end-to-end channel emulation]]。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing
[[DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing]] 是 [[2025RS Drone Solution]] 中引用 [[RTCA DO-160]] 作為 airborne equipment environmental conditions and test procedures 的測試線索，用於 military / aviation drone EMC proposal context。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › Section 20 — Radio Frequency Susceptibility
來源說此測試確保 EUT exposed to a level of RF modulated power 時不受影響，並分為：

- Conducted Susceptibility（low freq）。
- Radiated Susceptibility（high freq）。

來源說 emissions can come from equipment installed inside aircraft as well as external radiators such as radar stations；Conducted Susceptibility similar to [[CS114]] test，Radiated Susceptibility similar to [[RS103]]。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › Section 21 — Emission of RF Energy
來源說此測試確保 equipment does not emit excessive RF noise，以 protect aircraft sensors and receivers。來源分為：

- Conducted Emissions（low freq）。
- Radiated Emissions（high freq）。

標題中同列 [[RE102]] / CE，但未提供 limit table 或 exact mapping。

GFM314_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Rx_Tests › 7.6 Receiver Spurious Emissions
- Spurious emissions power 是 receiver 產生或放大的 emissions 出現在 BS receiver antenna connector 的功率。
- 測試需在 Tx 與 Rx 均開啟時執行，Tx port terminated。
- Receiver spurious emission limits 適用頻率範圍為 30 MHz 到 12.75 GHz；若 UL operating band upper frequency edge 的 5th harmonic 超過 12.75 GHz，範圍會延伸。
- Receiver spurious emission requirements：30 MHz–1 GHz 最大 -57.0 dBm、100 kHz measurement bandwidth；1 GHz–12.75 GHz 最大 -47.0 dBm、1 MHz measurement bandwidth；12.75 GHz–5th harmonic 最大 -47.0 dBm、1 MHz measurement bandwidth。
- Test setup：base station 依 TM1.1 以 rated output power 傳送 NR signal；FSW 透過 Tx notch filter 測量 Rx emissions；Tx 與其他 Rx ports terminated。

GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests › 6.7 Transmitter intermodulation
- 目的：評估 transmitter unit 抑制由 wanted signal 與 interfering signal 經由 antenna、RDN、antenna array 到達 transmitter unit 後，在 non-linear elements 中產生 signal 的能力。
- 測試時將 lowest supported channel bandwidth 的 NR signal 作為 interfering signal 注入 antenna connector。
- Interfering signal 的 mean power level 比 wanted signal 的 mean power 低 30 dB。
- Wanted signal：NR signal with NR-FR1-TM1.1。
- Interfering signal：NR signal with NR-FR1-TM1.1，minimum channel bandwidth，15 kHz SCS。
- Interferer level：P rated,t,AC - 30 dB。
- Frequency offset：±0.5 × BW Interferer（n=1）、±1.5 × BW Interferer（n=2）、±2.5 × BW Interferer（n=3）。
- Transmitter intermodulation 的量測條件與 ACLR（6.6.3）、OBUE / SEM（6.6.4）、Transmitter spurious emissions（6.6.5）相同。
- Intermodulation test 中，F1 是 wanted signal，F2 是 interferer。
- SMW manual testing procedure 需要 firmware higher than 4.70.026.51。
- SMW Test Case Wizard（TCW）以 [[3GPP TS 38.141-1]] Rel. 15 為基礎；來源說因 interferer parameter settings 與 Rel. 16 V16.3.0 相同，因此 TCW 可使用。

- **Fewer Boxes. More Capability.**：以 fewer calibrations、fewer licenses、lower TCO、higher test throughput 作為 sales message；來源未提供 TCO 算式。

[[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]] 建議用以下問題區分需求：

GFM314_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Rx_Tests › 7.7 Receiver Intermodulation
- Intermodulation response rejection 衡量 receiver 在 two interfering signals 存在下於 assigned channel frequency 接收 wanted signal 的能力。

### Short answer
To compare a Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer solution with a competitor for Aerospace / Defense, the evidence must include an A&D application source, our formal product specifications and configuration limits, competitor official or third-party-verified specifications, and a source that supports the exact comparison under comparable conditions.[2][3][6][7][12][16][31][66]
### Required evidence
| Required evidence | Why it is needed | Current support / gap |
|---|---|---|
| A source that ties the use case to Aerospace / Defense, not just to instruments in general. | The raw source only shows an Aerospace / Defense context by URL and separately names “Signal Generator” and “Signal Analyzer.” | The URL is an aerospace-defense page, and another raw passage only lists “Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer,” so the direct A&D solution-to-competitor comparison is not established by these passages.[98][99] |
| A&D test or application evidence, such as DO-160 EMC or satellite payload TVAC testing. | DO-160 is cited in a military / aviation drone EMC proposal context, and TVAC satellite payload test setups can include a signal generator and signal analyzer. | DO-160 context is supported, and TVAC setup components are supported, but neither passage compares R&S with a competitor.[16][31] |
| Our formal product documentation for the Signal Generator. | SMW200A claims should come from its configuration guide and specifications, which record configuration, ordering, RF/baseband performance, interfaces, environmental data and options. | SMW200A source documents are the configuration guide PD 3606.8037.92 Version 06.00 May 2024 and specifications PD 3606.8037.22 Version 31.00 May 2026.[2] |
| Our formal product documentation for the Signal Analyzer. | FSW claims should come from its specifications, because the FSW page notes the document version and that data without tolerance limits is not binding. | FSW specifications are PD 5215.6749.22 Version 17.01 September 2025, and the page notes data without tolerance limits is not binding.[6] |
| Comparable R&S specifications with conditions. | SMW200A product data applies only after ambient storage, warm-up, environmental compliance, calibration interval compliance and internal automatic adjustments. | SMW200A warranted and non-warranted terms are defined, including that typ., nominal and measured values are not guaranteed.[3] |
| Comparable analyzer specifications with conditions. | FSW product data applies only after ambient storage, warm-up, environmental compliance, calibration interval compliance and internal automatic adjustments. | FSW common conditions include calibration interval, temperature ranges, frequency resolution and AC supply information.[66] |
| Exact R&S model, option and bandwidth evidence. | SMW200A and FSW capability depends on RF path, baseband, analysis bandwidth and software options. | SMW200A supports RF path A up to 100 kHz to 67 GHz, RF path B up to 100 kHz to 44 GHz, and wideband RF modulation bandwidth up to 2 GHz with the cited conditions.[62] |
| Exact analyzer model, option and bandwidth evidence. | FSW capability depends on model and analysis bandwidth option. | FSW models cover up to 85 GHz, and FSW85 with FSW-B90G can extend to 90 GHz.[5][68] |
| Exact FSW analysis-bandwidth option evidence. | A fair analyzer comparison needs the installed bandwidth option rather than a generic FSW claim. | FSW analysis bandwidth options listed include 40 MHz, 80 MHz, 160 MHz, 320 MHz, 512 MHz, 1.2 GHz, 2 GHz, 4.4 GHz, 6.4 GHz and 8.312 GHz, with model and installation limits.[67] |
| Competitor official datasheets, configuration guides, release notes, option catalogs and test conditions. | Existing Keysight battle-card material is not Keysight official documentation and lacks formal SKU specifications, order numbers, option codes, release status and test conditions. | The Keysight page explicitly says Keysight-related competitor descriptions need Keysight official or third-party evidence, and that the battle card lacks formal datasheets, versions, order numbers, option codes, release status and test conditions.[7] |
| Competitor official evidence for Anritsu if Anritsu is the competitor. | Existing Anritsu material is an R&S internal battle card and cannot be treated as Anritsu official specifications or market facts. | Anritsu frequency range, bandwidth, data rate, option code, software tools and support model need Anritsu official datasheets, release notes or support terms.[12] |
| A source that directly supports any superiority, “only vendor,” ranking, lower TCO or fewer-boxes claim. | R&S battle-card superiority language is sales positioning, not binding technical specification. | The Anritsu comparison page says only-platform, industry-leading, widest-frequency-range and lower-TCO statements are sales language and should not be treated as verifiable technical specifications.[21] |
| A calculation or evidence base for TCO claims. | Lower TCO or fewer-calibration claims need a cited calculation or source. | The Anritsu offensive-plays passage says the “fewer boxes / lower TCO / higher throughput” message lacks a TCO formula.[87] |
| Official standards or test-plan evidence for A&D compliance claims. | The DO-160 page is not an official RTCA DO-160 standard summary and cannot support full category, limit, waveform, setup or pass/fail criteria claims. | The DO-160 page explicitly says not to infer full DO-160 section category, limit, waveform, setup or pass/fail criteria from it.[84] |
| Environmental and calibration evidence for satellite-payload or TVAC claims. | TVAC solution-level material is not a product qualification certificate and lacks chamber pressure, temperature profile, dwell time, calibration interval and uncertainty budget. | The TVAC page says the source does not provide those TVAC details and must not be treated as a product qualification certificate.[32] |
### Minimum evidence package before making the comparison
1. Identify the exact Aerospace / Defense test scenario, such as DO-160 RF susceptibility, RF emissions, lightning-induced transients, ESD, or satellite-payload TVAC testing, and cite the applicable standard or test procedure version.[17][18][81][82][83]  
2. Identify the exact R&S Signal Generator model, RF path, baseband module, bandwidth, software options and warranted specification conditions.[1][2][3][62][65]  
3. Identify the exact R&S Signal Analyzer model, frequency range, analysis-bandwidth option, firmware or measurement option and warranted specification conditions.[6][66][67][68][69]  
4. Identify the competitor model, hardware configuration, software/options, document version, release status and measurement conditions from competitor official documentation or third-party evidence.[7][12]  
5. Compare only metrics stated for both sides under comparable conditions, such as frequency range, modulation bandwidth, analysis bandwidth, software function, calibration conditions, environmental conditions and uncertainty treatment.[3][6][66][67]  
6. Exclude unsupported claims about market share, customer adoption, “only vendor,” lower TCO, fewer boxes or superiority unless a cited source directly supports that exact claim.[21][74][87]

GFM314_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Rx_Tests › 7.6 Receiver Spurious Emissions
- Spurious emissions power 是 receiver 產生或放大的 emissions 出現在 BS receiver antenna connector 的功率。
- 測試需在 Tx 與 Rx 均開啟時執行，Tx port terminated。
- Receiver spurious emission limits 適用頻率範圍為 30 MHz 到 12.75 GHz；若 UL operating band upper frequency edge 的 5th harmonic 超過 12.75 GHz，範圍會延伸。
- Receiver spurious emission requirements：30 MHz–1 GHz 最大 -57.0 dBm、100 kHz measurement bandwidth；1 GHz–12.75 GHz 最大 -47.0 dBm、1 MHz measurement bandwidth；12.75 GHz–5th harmonic 最大 -47.0 dBm、1 MHz measurement bandwidth。
- Test setup：base station 依 TM1.1 以 rated output power 傳送 NR signal；FSW 透過 Tx notch filter 測量 Rx emissions；Tx 與其他 Rx ports terminated。

GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests › 6.7 Transmitter intermodulation
- 目的：評估 transmitter unit 抑制由 wanted signal 與 interfering signal 經由 antenna、RDN、antenna array 到達 transmitter unit 後，在 non-linear elements 中產生 signal 的能力。
- 測試時將 lowest supported channel bandwidth 的 NR signal 作為 interfering signal 注入 antenna connector。
- Interfering signal 的 mean power level 比 wanted signal 的 mean power 低 30 dB。
- Wanted signal：NR signal with NR-FR1-TM1.1。
- Interfering signal：NR signal with NR-FR1-TM1.1，minimum channel bandwidth，15 kHz SCS。
- Interferer level：P rated,t,AC - 30 dB。
- Frequency offset：±0.5 × BW Interferer（n=1）、±1.5 × BW Interferer（n=2）、±2.5 × BW Interferer（n=3）。
- Transmitter intermodulation 的量測條件與 ACLR（6.6.3）、OBUE / SEM（6.6.4）、Transmitter spurious emissions（6.6.5）相同。
- Intermodulation test 中，F1 是 wanted signal，F2 是 interferer。
- SMW manual testing procedure 需要 firmware higher than 4.70.026.51。
- SMW Test Case Wizard（TCW）以 [[3GPP TS 38.141-1]] Rel. 15 為基礎；來源說因 interferer parameter settings 與 Rel. 16 V16.3.0 相同，因此 TCW 可使用。
- Python module `TC_6_7.py` 只包含 interfering generation process。
- 若要執行完整 6.7 Transmitter intermodulation test case，需要執行 `TC_6_7.py`、`TC_6_6_3.py`、`TC_6_6_4.py`、`TC_6_6_5.py`。

- Satellite payload qualification 需要使用 [[TVAC]] 進行 performance testing。

### Short answer
To compare a Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer solution with a competitor for Aerospace / Defense, the evidence must include an A&D application source, our formal product specifications and configuration limits, competitor official or third-party-verified specifications, and a source that supports the exact comparison under comparable conditions.[2][3][6][7][12][16][31][66]
### Required evidence
| Required evidence | Why it is needed | Current support / gap |
|---|---|---|
| A source that ties the use case to Aerospace / Defense, not just to instruments in general. | The raw source only shows an Aerospace / Defense context by URL and separately names “Signal Generator” and “Signal Analyzer.” | The URL is an aerospace-defense page, and another raw passage only lists “Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer,” so the direct A&D solution-to-competitor comparison is not established by these passages.[98][99] |
| A&D test or application evidence, such as DO-160 EMC or satellite payload TVAC testing. | DO-160 is cited in a military / aviation drone EMC proposal context, and TVAC satellite payload test setups can include a signal generator and signal analyzer. | DO-160 context is supported, and TVAC setup components are supported, but neither passage compares R&S with a competitor.[16][31] |
| Our formal product documentation for the Signal Generator. | SMW200A claims should come from its configuration guide and specifications, which record configuration, ordering, RF/baseband performance, interfaces, environmental data and options. | SMW200A source documents are the configuration guide PD 3606.8037.92 Version 06.00 May 2024 and specifications PD 3606.8037.22 Version 31.00 May 2026.[2] |
| Our formal product documentation for the Signal Analyzer. | FSW claims should come from its specifications, because the FSW page notes the document version and that data without tolerance limits is not binding. | FSW specifications are PD 5215.6749.22 Version 17.01 September 2025, and the page notes data without tolerance limits is not binding.[6] |
| Comparable R&S specifications with conditions. | SMW200A product data applies only after ambient storage, warm-up, environmental compliance, calibration interval compliance and internal automatic adjustments. | SMW200A warranted and non-warranted terms are defined, including that typ., nominal and measured values are not guaranteed.[3] |
| Comparable analyzer specifications with conditions. | FSW product data applies only after ambient storage, warm-up, environmental compliance, calibration interval compliance and internal automatic adjustments. | FSW common conditions include calibration interval, temperature ranges, frequency resolution and AC supply information.[66] |
| Exact R&S model, option and bandwidth evidence. | SMW200A and FSW capability depends on RF path, baseband, analysis bandwidth and software options. | SMW200A supports RF path A up to 100 kHz to 67 GHz, RF path B up to 100 kHz to 44 GHz, and wideband RF modulation bandwidth up to 2 GHz with the cited conditions.[62] |
| Exact analyzer model, option and bandwidth evidence. | FSW capability depends on model and analysis bandwidth option. | FSW models cover up to 85 GHz, and FSW85 with FSW-B90G can extend to 90 GHz.[5][68] |
| Exact FSW analysis-bandwidth option evidence. | A fair analyzer comparison needs the installed bandwidth option rather than a generic FSW claim. | FSW analysis bandwidth options listed include 40 MHz, 80 MHz, 160 MHz, 320 MHz, 512 MHz, 1.2 GHz, 2 GHz, 4.4 GHz, 6.4 GHz and 8.312 GHz, with model and installation limits.[67] |
| Competitor official datasheets, configuration guides, release notes, option catalogs and test conditions. | Existing Keysight battle-card material is not Keysight official documentation and lacks formal SKU specifications, order numbers, option codes, release status and test conditions. | The Keysight page explicitly says Keysight-related competitor descriptions need Keysight official or third-party evidence, and that the battle card lacks formal datasheets, versions, order numbers, option codes, release status and test conditions.[7] |
| Competitor official evidence for Anritsu if Anritsu is the competitor. | Existing Anritsu material is an R&S internal battle card and cannot be treated as Anritsu official specifications or market facts. | Anritsu frequency range, bandwidth, data rate, option code, software tools and support model need Anritsu official datasheets, release notes or support terms.[12] |
| A source that directly supports any superiority, “only vendor,” ranking, lower TCO or fewer-boxes claim. | R&S battle-card superiority language is sales positioning, not binding technical specification. | The Anritsu comparison page says only-platform, industry-leading, widest-frequency-range and lower-TCO statements are sales language and should not be treated as verifiable technical specifications.[21] |
| A calculation or evidence base for TCO claims. | Lower TCO or fewer-calibration claims need a cited calculation or source. | The Anritsu offensive-plays passage says the “fewer boxes / lower TCO / higher throughput” message lacks a TCO formula.[87] |
| Official standards or test-plan evidence for A&D compliance claims. | The DO-160 page is not an official RTCA DO-160 standard summary and cannot support full category, limit, waveform, setup or pass/fail criteria claims. | The DO-160 page explicitly says not to infer full DO-160 section category, limit, waveform, setup or pass/fail criteria from it.[84] |
| Environmental and calibration evidence for satellite-payload or TVAC claims. | TVAC solution-level material is not a product qualification certificate and lacks chamber pressure, temperature profile, dwell time, calibration interval and uncertainty budget. | The TVAC page says the source does not provide those TVAC details and must not be treated as a product qualification certificate.[32] |
### Minimum evidence package before making the comparison
1. Identify the exact Aerospace / Defense test scenario, such as DO-160 RF susceptibility, RF emissions, lightning-induced transients, ESD, or satellite-payload TVAC testing, and cite the applicable standard or test procedure version.[17][18][81][82][83]  
2. Identify the exact R&S Signal Generator model, RF path, baseband module, bandwidth, software options and warranted specification conditions.[1][2][3][62][65]  
3. Identify the exact R&S Signal Analyzer model, frequency range, analysis-bandwidth option, firmware or measurement option and warranted specification conditions.[6][66][67][68][69]  
4. Identify the competitor model, hardware configuration, software/options, document version, release status and measurement conditions from competitor official documentation or third-party evidence.[7][12]  
5. Compare only metrics stated for both sides under comparable conditions, such as frequency range, modulation bandwidth, analysis bandwidth, software function, calibration conditions, environmental conditions and uncertainty treatment.[3][6][66][67]  
6. Exclude unsupported claims about market share, customer adoption, “only vendor,” lower TCO, fewer boxes or superiority unless a cited source directly supports that exact claim.[21][74][87]
